question: Select the most appropriate word to fill blank no. 9
solution:
The correct answer is '**curdled**'.

• The sentence describes the friends' reaction of extreme fear or horror on seeing the form.
 
• The correct word should convey the sense of horror and how it affects their blood.
 
• "**Curdled**" fits perfectly as it means to congeal or become thickened, often used metaphorically to describe the chilling effect of fear on their blood.
